resources.string: Loop notices your habits on its own and tells you what they mean, in plain words.
Steps, sleep and screen time, tracked without you lifting a finger
A quick mood and energy check three times a day
Simple insights, like how your sleep changes your mood
Everything Loop learns stays on this phone. There\'s no account to create and no Loop server.

If you add your own free Gemini key, meal photos are sent to Google to recognise the food. On the free tier, Google may use these photos to improve its products. You can skip this and log food by hand.
Backups go to your own Google Drive through Android, or to a file you export yourself.
Both are optional and stay on this phone.
Used to estimate calories burned. You can change it any time in Me › About you.
Loop will also add a private period tracker under Me. It never shows on the Today screen, and you can turn it off in Settings.
Your four rings fill up as Loop learns your day: Move, Sleep, Screen and Fuel. Turn on each tracker when you\'re ready, from Me › Permissions.
